guideline: Participants ranked images based on four evaluation questions: Cultural Representation, Naturalness of Keyword, Offensiveness, and Description/Image Alignment

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate criteria and normalized naming for consistency

overall_notes: The extraction quality was generally good. Paper focuses on culturally-aware text-to-image generation through prompt refinement. Important to note that while the primary NLG aspect is prompt generation/refinement, the ultimate outputs being evaluated are images. Human evaluation was conducted with 66 participants from 8 countries using ranking methodology.
